supervisor.kind: external owned-child supervisor; monotonic clock (host monotonic origin shared by parent and child). The total deadline starts in the parent before reading the plan or any verification; the child verifies before any payload launch and starts slots only before deadline - kill_reserve - finalization; the parent kills only its owned adapter group at deadline - kill_reserve, writes only into a freshly created supervisor directory under work/endpoint_supervisor_runs/, measures the plan's run directory only when bound by this execution's run token, and judges the deadline at the final totals boundary
